sources.title: Confused
markers: | effects = * Affected entity is [[hostile]] to everyone, wanders around aimlessly, and occasionally skips turns in its stupor

summary: Cast level-5 Confusion once per Long Rest.

fields.Confusion: Action, 60 ft range and about 26 ft radius at level 5. Non-allied creatures make Wisdom saves against your spell save DC. Concentration up to 3 turns. Each affected creature saves again at the start of its turn. On a failure a hidden roll of 1–10 causes Stupor, while 11–20 uses madness AI to choose attacks. Madness can target friend or foe.
fields.Base value: 360 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
